reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept BLANK [WHEN] ZERO (WHEN optional, the key word ZERO only) once per entry on an elementary numeric or numeric-edited display item and blank the item when its value is zero, and refuse ZEROS/ZEROES, a missing ZERO, a missing BLANK, a repeated clause and the subjects SR1/SR2 exclude; the witness covers only the ZERO spelling refusal.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 the 'S' symbol beside BLANK WHEN ZERO is accepted (§1985:VI.5.4.3 SR1 takes any numeric PICTURE, kb/Work PB5191) and the '*' refusal cites §1985:VI.5.9.3 SR7; from 2002 both are refused

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition|IsActive over DataBinder.ClausePlacement.cs, CheckClauseSubjectsPass.cs (only SynchronizedViolation is edition-keyed) and the grammar rule; grep BLANK WHEN ZERO with edition/1985 over the compiler
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the format; yes for its subject: PIC S9(3) BLANK WHEN ZERO compiles at 85 and is COBOL1934 at 2002 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: only the ZEROS/ZEROES refusal; the WHEN-less spelling, the blanking behaviour and the other refusals are not exercised

reader.notes: The format is right at 85. Lead for the GR2 row, not this one: at 85 PIC S9(3) BLANK WHEN ZERO given -3 displays [003] and IF X < 0 is false (bzs2.cob), while a plain S9(3) holds -003; the 1985 text makes the item numeric edited (GR2) and leaves the S's meaning open, so the sign loss deserves its own adjudication.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85 (bz_a.cob etc. in E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-001/): VALUE ZERO on PIC 9(3) BWZ shows [000] and on ZZ9.9 [00000] (cite.py OK  §1985:VI.5.15.4 GR1c 'Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO'); scaled 9PP given 50 -> [ ] and 500 -> [5]; PPP9 given 0.00001 -> [ ], 0.0001 -> [1]; COMPUTE 7-7 -> [   ]; COMPUTE 999+1 ON SIZE ERROR -> SIZE and the item unchanged; MOVE -0 to 9(3)CR BWZ -> blank, -12 -> [012CR]; 0.001 into 9V99 BWZ -> blank (cite.py OK  §1985:VI.5.4.4 GR1). VALUE 0 (numeric literal) on 9(3) BWZ refused COBOL0900, which is right at 85 since GR2 makes it numeric edited and §1985:VI.5.15.4 GR1b (cite.py OK) requires nonnumeric literals. Refusals: bz_b.cob group USAGE COMP child with BWZ refused (COBOL0881, misleading text but SR2 enforced, cite.py OK §1985:VI.5.4.3 SR2); bz_c.cob '*' with BWZ COBOL1934; bz_d.cob BWZ+JUST COBOL2405; bz_e.cob USAGE INDEX and PIC X(3) subjects COBOL2405. ZEROS/ZEROES refusal stands: the 1985 format prints only the key word ZERO.
